paragraphs: A clerk's day divides between arrivals and departures. Mornings concentrate on receiving, afternoons on picking and shipping, with system entry and spot counts between. E-commerce promotions and factory changeovers require continuous work and late logistics coordination; normal periods are regular but demand accuracy across hundreds of daily transactions.
